description: Structured data from any document for AI agents, $0.25 per call: send a PDF, DOCX, XLSX, HTML, image or plain text plus a JSON Schema, get back one JSON object filled from the document — invoices, contracts, forms, CVs, receipts. Fields the document does not state come back null. One call, url or base64 (max 10 MB). Unreadable input means a 400 and you pay nothing. USDC on Base, no account.

file_base64.description: The file bytes, base64-encoded. Send this OR url.

filename.description: Optional original filename of file_base64 (its extension helps detect the type)

media_type.description: Optional MIME type of file_base64 (helps tell DOCX/XLSX apart)

schema.description: JSON Schema (type: object, with properties) describing the fields to extract

text.description: Plain document text instead of a file (max 120k chars)

url.description: http(s) link to the file; we fetch it. Send this OR file_base64.

name: doc_extract
